article_title: Trump's green card curbs test Indian tech workers' American dream

tasks.prompt: What central contrast does the article draw about the new PERM restrictions?
options: They will immediately bankrupt the eight affected firms but leave workers unharmed.
They may have a limited business impact while profoundly disrupting Indian workers' lives and long-term plans.
They make it easier for Indian graduates to obtain US citizenship.
They affect only American employees replacing overseas workers.
tasks.correct_answer: They may have a limited business impact while profoundly disrupting Indian workers' lives and long-term plans.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדגישה שההשפעה העסקית עשויה להיות קטנה, אך הפגיעה האנושית בעובדים ובמשפחותיהם יכולה להיות עמוקה.

tasks.prompt: What has happened to PERM applications involving the eight named technology firms?
options: New and pending applications have been frozen.
All applications were approved automatically.
Only applications from Microsoft remain open.
Applications were transferred to Indian courts.
tasks.correct_answer: New and pending applications have been frozen.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, בקשות PERM חדשות ותלויות ועומדות של החברות שנכללו בצעד הוקפאו.

tasks.prompt: What does “cost arbitrage” mean in the article's discussion of offshoring?
options: Charging every worker the same salary worldwide
Using court action to cancel immigration fees
Taking advantage of lower operating or labour costs in another location
Replacing remote work with office work
tasks.correct_answer: Taking advantage of lower operating or labour costs in another location
tasks.explanation_hebrew: cost arbitrage מתאר ניצול פערי עלויות בין מדינות, למשל העברת עבודה למקום שבו עלויות העבודה נמוכות יותר.

tasks.prompt: According to the NFAP figures cited, what share of pending employment-based green-card applications involved Indian nationals?
options: About one quarter
Just over half
Nearly all applications from eight firms
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדוח המצוטט קובע שכמעט מיליון הודים היו בתור, והם היו 79% מכלל הבקשות התלויות ועומדות.

tasks.prompt: Why might moving to an employer not covered by the suspension be difficult even if it is legally possible?
options: Other firms may fear retaliation, and layoffs and AI-driven restructuring make job changes harder.
US law forbids H-1B holders from changing employers under any circumstances.
All technology firms have stopped hiring American workers.
A move would require an immediate $800,000 investment.
tasks.correct_answer: Other firms may fear retaliation, and layoffs and AI-driven restructuring make job changes harder.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שמעסיקים אחרים עלולים לחשוש מתגובה ממשלתית, ובמקביל פיטורים, קיצוצים ובינה מלאכותית מקשים על מעבר עבודה.

tasks.prompt: What does the article mean by “rewriting the script” for Indian professionals?
options: Changing computer code used in visa applications
Correcting errors in the PERM Tracker data
Rethinking the familiar career path of moving to the US and settling there
Writing a new law that guarantees citizenship
tasks.correct_answer: Rethinking the familiar career path of moving to the US and settling there
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מטפורי: המסלול המוכר מלימודים ועבודה בהודו אל ויזה, גרין קארד וחיים בארה״ב כבר אינו בטוח ולכן צריך לחשוב עליו מחדש.

tasks.prompt: Give two pieces of evidence that Indian technology companies have reduced their reliance on the H-1B-to-PERM pathway.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא שתי ראיות מספריות או עובדתיות מהכתבה על גיוס מקומי או הירידה בבקשות PERM.
expected_points: Nasscom says Indian firms are hiring more workers locally in the US.
Wipro says more than 80% of its US workforce is locally hired.
TCS said its PERM applications were in single digits in the past two years.
A cited report said TCS filings fell from 1,804 to 513 and then to two.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the effects of the PERM suspension on companies, workers and the possible location of future technology jobs.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין השפעה עסקית, השפעה אנושית ושינוי אפשרי באופן שבו חברות משתמשות בכישרון הודי.
expected_points: Companies say they have already hired more locally and filed fewer PERM applications, so direct business effects may be limited.
Workers may face stalled permanent-residency plans, family disruption and greater uncertainty.
Alternative green-card routes are limited, expensive or potentially vulnerable to future restrictions.
Some work may be offshored to India rather than transferred to American employees.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article suggest that the consequences extend beyond immigration paperwork?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההשלכות על משפחות, זהות, כספים, יחס ציבורי ותכנון עתידי, תוך הסתמכות על הכתבה.
expected_points: Some workers have built lives in the US while their children have grown up there.
Many borrowed heavily to study and establish careers.
Long waits and frozen applications reduce their ability to plan or absorb further costs.
Rising online hostility and offensive rhetoric add social pressure to legal uncertainty.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced paragraph using “backlog”, “offshoring” and “permanent residency” to explain what may happen next.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלושת המונחים במדויק, להציג יותר מאפשרות אחת, ולהימנע מניבוי ודאי מעבר לעובדות הכתבה.
expected_points: Mention the large backlog and long projected waits for many Indian applicants.
Explain that tighter routes to permanent residency may cause some workers to reconsider moving or staying.
Explain that companies may respond through local hiring or offshoring work to India.
Acknowledge that demand for Indian technology talent may continue even if the employment model changes.
